name: elagoht/gesso
description: A collage plugin that runs a gesso application's lifecycle: its modules start when collage starts serving and stop after collage's server has stopped.
setup: The plugin needs the gesso app it runs: build it in `plugins.go` or pass it in — `api, err := gesso.New(gesso.Config{BasePath: "/api"}, …)` — mount it with `app.Handle("/api/", api)`, and list `gesso.New(gesso.Options{App: api})`. Without an app, startup fails.
